jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with a track record protecting defenders across specific regions, which the candidate lacks, and it is not a genuine salaried vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation subject is genuinely interesting, but the advisory-expert framing is a hard mismatch for an early-career applicant.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this role is based in Washington, DC with no London option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow role well above entry level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a think-tank is a senior, experienced research position well above entry level, requiring an established policy track record the candidate lacks. The climate-development topic also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: The "Lead" title signals a non-entry-level role, and it requires ISO-standards auditing qualifications and technical experience the candidate does not have. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest areas.

jobs.title: Strategic Accounts Manager
jobs.reason: Requires 7+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, a senior "Manager" title, and a proven sales/quota track record — well beyond entry-level and a hard disqualifier. It is also a cybersecurity sales role with no fit to the candidate's research and policy background or interests.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor, Responsible Sourcing
jobs.reason: "Lead" title plus essential requirements of minimum two years of social-compliance auditing, 100+ verifiable audit days, APSCA/CSCA registration and fluent English AND Spanish — none of which the candidate holds. The Spanish-fluency essential and the specialist auditing credentials are hard disqualifiers, and the topic is only tangential to the candidate's core interests.

jobs.title: Surveyor Center
jobs.reason: Requires an engineering / materials-science degree and 5–6 years of professional experience — both essential requirements the candidate plainly lacks. It is a technical inspection/surveyor role with no connection to the candidate's research or policy profile.

jobs.title: Contractor on Demand (Lead auditor Cyber - ISO 27001)
jobs.reason: This role requires ISO 27001 lead-auditor qualification and cyber-audit competencies the candidate does not hold, and the "Lead auditor" level with professional certification is a hard mismatch for an early-career researcher. It is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and skill set.

jobs.title: ECD Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a technical industrial-inspection role requiring specialist certifications (PED Module H, ISO 3834-2 welding assessment) the candidate does not hold and could not quickly acquire. It is entirely outside the candidate's research/policy profile and interest zones, and the essential technical qualifications are unmet.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert Advisory Committee members, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established experts to advise the project, which the candidate (a student without professional expertise) does not qualify as, and it appears to be a voluntary/speculative advisory position rather than a concrete paid vacancy. The human-rights subject is interesting, but the seniority/expert framing and lack of a paid role gate it out.

jobs.title: Security Consultant - Governance Risk Compliance
jobs.reason: This is a technical cybersecurity GRC consulting role requiring practical experience delivering GRC engagements, working knowledge of IT/OT/ICS security, networking and operating systems — a substantial technical skills gap the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-technical profile cannot meet. The role also requires residence in Singapore and is a consultant-level position expecting independent engagement delivery, none of which fits the candidate's academic international-law and policy background.

jobs.title: OSINT Investigator - Contractor - Arabic speaker - Sudan
jobs.reason: Ineligible: Arabic at C1/Professional level is an essential requirement the candidate does not meet (working languages are German/English, French only B1). The role also requires a proven OSINT investigation track record the candidate lacks. Although CIR and atrocity documentation are a perfect interest match, the language and experience essentials are hard blockers.

jobs.title: Product and Delivery Manager, Centre for Collective Intelligence
jobs.reason: This is a "Manager" role with essential requirements for a track record of owning a digital product end-to-end, agile product management, and leading products through scaling — clearly not entry-level and beyond the candidate's student-assistant experience. The digital-participation subject is mildly adjacent, but the seniority and product-management essentials are hard mismatches.

jobs.title: Community Network Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title signals a non-entry-level role, which is a hard disqualifier for a candidate with no full-time professional experience. The public-law / legal-charity context is adjacent to the candidate's interests, but the seniority level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant
jobs.reason: This is a manual warehouse / logistics role requiring physical handling and stock-control experience — a complete mismatch for an academic-research profile, though nothing in it triggers a hard disqualifier (it is a paid, non-managerial role with only a soft 1–2 year ask). It sits entirely outside all three interest zones and offers no paper-fit alignment, so it barely warrants surfacing.

jobs.title: Assistant Property Asset Manager
jobs.reason: Eligible on a technicality — the role is London-based, entry-to-junior, and does not require an unmet essential qualification (property qualification is only desirable). But it demands property-investment knowledge and asset-management experience the candidate does not have, and it sits entirely outside all three interest zones; it is a poor fit on nearly every axis.

jobs.title: Senior Policy Advisor, Trade Diplomacy, Japan
jobs.reason: The "Senior Policy Advisor" title indicates a seniority level requiring several years of relevant experience the candidate does not have, which is a hard disqualifier. The focus on Japan trade diplomacy also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones and would likely favour Japan-focused expertise.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow & Head of Organised Crime & Policing
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — a "Senior Research Fellow & Head of" role requiring 9 years of experience far exceeds the candidate's student-assistant background. RUSI and security research are of genuine interest, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Process Intelligence Analyst
jobs.reason: The role's essential requirements — expertise in BI tooling (Looker, BigQuery, Tableau/PowerBI), process mining, BPM frameworks, and Agile/Lean/Six Sigma — plus demonstrable years of experience in data science/process intelligence, are a substantial skills gap beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python/SPSS. It also sits well outside all three interest zones as an internal publishing-operations optimisation role.

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Discover Journals
jobs.reason: The role's essential requirement is a PhD (or MS with research/publishing experience) in medicine and life science, and it is framed as a scientific/medical editorial post in a field wholly outside the candidate's background. It is a poor paper fit and sits outside all three interest zones; the level and subject-matter mismatch make it unwinnable.

jobs.title: Trusts & Grants Manager
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — this is a Manager role requiring strategic direction and "dynamic leadership" of a team and portfolio, which the candidate's student-assistant background cannot meet. Fundraising/trusts work is also outside the core interest zones.
jobs.location: Flexible across England, Wales and Northern Ireland (London option)

jobs.title: Curation Editor
jobs.reason: Ineligible on the experience gate — the role requires 3+ years' digital publishing experience in a news environment, plus prior homepage-editor experience, which is well beyond the candidate's student-assistant/RA background. It is also a digital-journalism/curation role outside the candidate's research and policy interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Integrity Partner Adviser
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is "demonstrable experience high performing as a Research Integrity Adviser or in an equivalent role," plus familiarity with academic-publishing systems, plagiarism/image-manipulation software and copyright law — a specialist professional profile the candidate does not have. Although the candidate has academic-publishing exposure and a graduate-level HSS background, this is a mid-career specialist role rather than an entry-level position, and it sits outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Research Integrity Partner Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" role with essential requirements of demonstrable research-integrity experience at a publisher and line-management experience, both of which the candidate lacks — this is not entry-level and trips the seniority disqualifier. The academic-publishing topic is tangential to the candidate's core interests, but the level and experience requirements are the decisive block.

jobs.title: Centre Manager
jobs.reason: The role requires a "proven track-record in end-to-end project management" as an essential, at Grade 7 with a Manager title — this is not entry-level and demands project-management experience the candidate (student-assistant/RA only) does not have. It is also administrative/events-management focused on sustainable economic transformation in developing countries, outside the core interest zones.
jobs.location: Bloomsbury, Camden, Greater London, United Kingdom
jobs.salary: £43,297.57 to £50,562.57 per annum (inclusive of London Allowance, pro rata)

jobs.title: Embedded Cyber Detection and Response Analyst
jobs.reason: Ineligible on two counts: it requires 3–5 years of cybersecurity experience the candidate lacks, and it is a deep-technical security-operations / SOC role (SIEM, EDR/XDR, threat hunting, malware analysis) far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and outside any security-operations background. Despite being at Control Risks, this is not the analyst work in the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Study Abroad Coordinator
jobs.reason: This post is explicitly open to internal LSE applicants only ("Any external applications will not be considered"), and the candidate is a student, not an LSE staff member, so cannot apply. Beyond that, the essential requirements centre on communications, social media, events management, CRM (Salesforce) and video editing — the candidate's weakest areas and outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Global Total Rewards Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: A Manager-level role requiring extensive, progressive compensation/HR experience with Workday Advanced Compensation — clearly not entry-level and demanding years of specialised post-graduation experience the candidate lacks. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy field.

jobs.title: Embedded Cyber Detection and Response Deputy Team Lead
jobs.reason: Requires 7+ years of cybersecurity experience and a "Deputy Team Lead" leadership title, both hard disqualifiers on level and experience. It is also a deep-technical security-operations role (SIEM/EDR/SOAR, forensics, threat hunting) far outside the candidate's analysis-level skills and with no security-ops background.

jobs.title: Research Fellow / Postdoctoral Researcher in Political Economy of Structural Transformation
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed or near-completed PhD ("will have, or be close to completing, a PhD"), which the candidate does not hold — a hard disqualifier for postdoctoral positions. The subject matter (development economics, structural transformation) also sits outside the candidate's core international-law and security interests.
jobs.salary: £43,297.57 to £50,562.57 per annum inclusive of London Allowance
